response.sql: WITH account_averages AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) AS average_amount FROM trans GROUP BY account_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_amount) AS overall_average FROM account_averages) SELECT a.account_id, a.average_amount, a.average_amount - o.overall_average AS excess FROM account_averages AS a CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE a.average_amount > o.overall_average ORDER BY excess DESC, a.account_id LIMIT 10;
